Void Staff

3000 goldFinished item

A mage item with ability power and 40% magic penetration, which lets your magic damage ignore part of the enemy's magic resist.

Stats

  • 95 Ability Power
  • 40% Magic Penetration

What it does

Only the stats.

When to buy it

Buy it as a second or third item when enemies start buying magic resist, especially tanks.

Skip it whenIf nobody on the enemy team has magic resist, other damage items help more.

Good on

Ahri Syndra Viktor Veigar Lux Fizz

Builds from

Blighting Jewel Blasting Wand
